Reception Admissions 2026 – How offers were made
(Please Note: These figures do not include late applications)
The schools in this table received more applications than places available and this means places could not be offered to every applicant. The table gives
information about offers as at 16 April 2026. These figures will change if places are declined and then offered to other pupils from the waiting list. For full data
relating to faith schools please contact schools directly.
